definitions.explanation: Prefix indicating the first occurrence or beginning stage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This is my first overseas trip.
examples.notes: {初|はじ}めて = for the first time

examples.japanese: ⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大成功|だいせいこう}→大成功：03114_daiseikou⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The opening day performance was a great success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Even beginners can do it easily.

notes:
{初|しょ}〜 is a prefix meaning 'first' or 'initial.'

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧ (first day; opening day)
- ⟦{初回|しょかい}→初回：11780_shokai⟧ (first time; first round)
- ⟦{初心|しょしん}→初心：08656_shoshin⟧ (original intention; beginner's mind)
- ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧ (beginner)
- ⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧ (early stage; initial period)
- ⟦{初歩|しょほ}→初歩：00375_shoho⟧ (basics; rudiments)
- ⟦{初夏|しょか}→初夏：11740_shoka⟧ (early summer)
- ⟦{初冬|しょとう}→初冬：08712_shotou⟧ (early winter)
- ⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧ (first meeting)

OTHER READINGS:
{初|はつ}〜 is another reading used in compounds like:
- ⟦{初恋|はつこい}→初恋：17445_hatsukoi⟧ (first love)
- ⟦{初雪|はつゆき}→初雪：11784_hatsuyuki⟧ (first snow of the season)
- ⟦{初夢|はつゆめ}→初夢：16702_hatsuyume⟧ (first dream of the new year)

These often relate to seasonal or personal 'firsts.'
